summary:
D.C. statehood advocates are intensifying efforts ahead of the midterm elections, with a senator committing to prioritize the issue and organizations highlighting recent events—including federal troop deployment and threats to fiscal independence—as evidence for why statehood is urgent. These campaigns are unfolding as advocates work to build support both within Congress and across other states.

Without statehood, Congress can override any law D.C. passes and can impose restrictions on how the District spends its locally generated tax revenue.

articles.title: Eyeing the midterm elections, D.C. is taking the fight for statehood to the states
